title: Affection
subtitle: How the bot feels about each person, isolated per instance
scopeBanner: Only affection under this instance is listed and editable; other instances stay invisible

columns.mergedInto: Merged into {{person}}; this row is dormant, editing it has no effect

empty.title: Nobody remembered yet
empty.hint: Affection builds up as conversations happen. If nothing shows up, enable the affection system in system settings first.

scope.notInUseWarning: No channel currently uses this share: channels are using this person's share under another preset, so changes here won't affect ongoing conversations.

detail.title: This relationship
detail.scopeLine: This affection belongs to: domain {{domain}} / preset {{preset}}
detail.presetDeleted: That preset was deleted; this data is kept as an orphan (never cascade-deleted, clean it up manually under Console → Identity & Domains)

adjustDialog.title: Adjust affection
adjustDialog.description: Set the score of {{share}} directly. Only the score changes; to change the impression use "Edit impression" or "Clear impression only".
adjustDialog.scoreHelper: Ranges from -100 to 200; values outside are clamped
adjustDialog.reasonHelper: Recorded in the change history for later reference

resetDialog.title: Reset affection
resetDialog.description: This clears the score of {{share}} and wipes the impression the bot wrote. Shares under other presets are not affected; it will build up again from the next conversation.

clearDialog.title: Clear impression only
clearDialog.description: This wipes the impression and the recent note of {{share}}. The score stays. The bot will write a new one after the next conversation.

editDialog.title: Edit impression
editDialog.description: Rewrite the impression and the recent note of {{share}}. The score stays. Later conversations will keep evolving it from here.
editDialog.lengthHelper: Up to {{max}} characters; anything longer is cut off on save

deleteReasonDialog.title: Delete this reason
deleteReasonDialog.description: Only the reason text of this entry is removed: the score and the entry itself stay, with a deletion trace. The impression and recent note are not affected; use "Clear impression only" or "Edit impression" for those.

messages.loadFailed: Failed to load the affection list
